description: Build a best man speech outline — opening, anecdotes, jokes, heartfelt middle, and toast — personalized with names.

faqs.a: Your name, the groom's name, the partner's name, a funny memory, and how you know the groom — the tool builds a full outline.
faqs.q: What do I need to enter?

faqs.a: Opening, funny story, heartfelt story, jokes, advice, and the toast — in classic speech order.
Funny, Heartfelt, or Short & Sweet — pick the vibe for your speech.
Copy it or download as a .txt file to rehearse.

howto: Enter names and a funny memory.
Pick the jokes and tone you like.
Generate your outline, then copy or download.
title: Best Man Speech Generator
